title: PairedConfirmed
description: Server -> client. Sent to both sides once the pairing record exists -- to the desktop only if it is still connected. Each side receives the other side's identity.

pairingId.description: Handle for revoking this pairing via DELETE /api/v1/pairings/{pairingId}.

peerDeviceId.description: The other device. This is what the phone later sends as `connectRequest.targetDeviceId`.
